notes.title: English Language Beta Test for New Version
notes.notes:
Howdy!

Today, I've got something special for you, the first edition of the remake for Her Heart's Desire. Before I go and finish everything, I wanted to share the initial first episode as a beta (English only, for now) and collect feedback.

What's in the remake Her Heart's Desire 1.1 edition?


 700+ new images, and just shy of 900 images in total.
 9 new animations, which are a remake of the first animated scene in game
 94 new audio files including new sound effects & music tracks
 Completely rewritten story, the first 22,000 words in this version
 New game over experiences if you choose unwisely
 Updated all the transitions to standardize them
 Rebuilt in Ren'py 8 for faster, better performance & experience


If you have time and are so inclined, I'd love to get your take on this newly revamped experience. What's good? Could be better? Anything missing? That sort of thing.

Thanks a ton,
Brosef

notes.title: Harem Ever After Content Expansion & Update
notes.notes:
What's special in the Harem Ever After update?


 Rewritten introduction, multiple other scenes as well, for clarity and quality. Every scene file was at least partially rewritten in this update to ensure the main character is always the narrator which reduces the potential confusion.
 Three new fully animated scenes, with more than 26 animations, some with 30, 40, or even 60 frames - yeah, I tried to push things & improve in that area too.
 Twenty plus new renders in my latest visual style, a significant upgrade to the previous styling in the game.
 43 scenes in the replay feature, now when replaying a scene you can experience every scene the same way as it happened in the game.
 Compressed animations to shrink the game footprint from 7.7 gigabytes to just over 5 gigs; this includes the new content as well. 
 Added character label & italics to all the lines where the main character was thinking, but it didn't have a label.
 Reworked sounds, the man laughing in particular, as well as others that didn't have the same high quality as the remainder. 
 Customization has been simplified, enabling people who don't want to customize all the text to skip many questions in the game & focus on the story.
